name: Kuramitsuga
bio: The Broken Reach is a realm not wide, but deep – go too far through its countless portals, and you find a world of naught but cold and haunting starlight. The first Cambion to discover it sought to forge a Titan from their memories of it, to end the nightmares. They are gone. Kuramitsuga endures.
subtitle: The Shattered Ghost
